_note: Answers for easyapply.mjs (LinkedIn Easy Apply). Copy to config/easyapply-answers.json (gitignored) and replace every value. Injected into the page as window.__A.
_sponsorship: needsSponsorship answers generic 'will you need sponsorship?' questions. unrestrictedRightToWork answers 'can you work WITHOUT sponsorship / indefinite leave / settled status?' questions, which are always checked first.
_extraRules: [regex, answer] pairs checked right after the sponsorship rule, before the built-in rules. Use them for skill questions.
extraRules: access and excel|analytical reports|excel experience|microsoft access
_workExperienceFix: Optional. If LinkedIn pre-fills a Work Experience description that you don't want on applications, set match (regex on the old text) and replacement. Delete this key to skip.

workExperienceFix.match: text that only appears in the description you want to replace
workExperienceFix.replacement:
Data analysis and reporting for consultancy clients.
- Built a Power BI report that replaced weekly spreadsheet reporting.
